steps.say: Food gives your body energy and the materials it needs to grow. Different foods do different jobs.
Carbohydrates such as rice give energy. Proteins such as fish, eggs and tempeh help you grow and repair.
steps.show: carbohydrates for energy, proteins for growth

steps.say: Fruit and vegetables give vitamins, minerals and fibre. A balanced meal has food from several groups.
Exercise makes your heart, lungs and muscles stronger. Sleep helps your body grow and repair itself.
Some microorganisms cause illness. Washing your hands with soap removes most of them.

figure.alt: A pair of hands and a bar of soap.

steps.say: Other microorganisms are useful. Yeasts and moulds help us make bread, tempeh and tapai.

check.prompt: Which food group gives us most of our energy?

options.why: Proteins mainly help the body grow and repair itself.
Vitamins help keep the body working well, but they do not give energy.
Fibre helps food move through the gut.

hints: Think about what rice, bread and noodles give you.
This food group is found in grains and potatoes.
Cross out the groups for growing and for digestion.
check.explanation: Carbohydrates, found in foods such as rice, bread and noodles, give us most of our energy.

check.prompt: Washing your hands with ___ removes most microorganisms.
hints: It makes bubbles and lather on your hands.
You use it with water at the sink.
check.explanation: Soap lifts microorganisms off your skin so that water can wash them away.
